evidence.quote: The language of instruction is English for the first two semesters. Classes are conducted in German from the third semester onward.
Tuition fees per semester The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: EU countries 0 EUR The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR

International degree-seeking students from non-EU countries pay the full semester contribution + tuition fees each semester. Winter semester 2026/27: 194.60 EUR semester contribution + 1,500 EUR tuition fee = 1,694.60 EUR
Next intake for winter semester 2027/28 Application portal will open 15 April 2027
Recommended application timeline 15 May latest for international applicants (for visa reasons)
Apply online via our application portal: https://campus.th-mannheim.de

Required application documents School leaving certificates with grades and university transcripts of your current course of studies (if you are studying already) -- Upload one combined pdf scan max. size 5 MB. English language proof (IELTS, TOEFL, OTE) CV (written in English and up-to-date) Letter of reference (written in English) from one of your teachers or professors, preferably in Maths or Physics Motivational letter (written in English, maximum one A4 page)
B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 88

note.fr: Un certificat de langue anglaise officiel est requis ; les scores acceptés incluent IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 88, OTE 130.
note.en: An official English language certificate is required; accepted scores include IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 88, OTE 130.

evidence.quote: English language skills needed Proof of sufficient English language skills is one of the admission prerequisites (TOEFL minimum 88 (IBT) or 4.5; IELTS minimum 6.5; OTE minimum 130).
Letter of reference (written in English) from one of your teachers or professors, preferably in Maths or Physics

note.fr: Un diplôme d'entrée à l'université est requis et l'admission dépend des performances académiques dans la matière concernée.
note.en: A university entrance qualification is required and admission is based on academic performance in the subject concerned.

evidence.quote: A university / higher education entrance qualification is required. Admission is based on the applicant's academic and professional performance in the subject concerned.

note.fr: De très bonnes notes sont attendues, notamment en maths et en physique.
note.en: Very good grades are expected, especially in mathematics and physics.

evidence.quote: applicants should have a very good school-leaving certificate or university transcript. Our admissions committee focuses on your grades in Maths and Physics.

note.fr: L'allemand n'est pas obligatoire pour l'admission ; l'allemand A2 est recommandé.
note.en: German language skills are not mandatory for admission; German level A2 is recommended.

evidence.quote: German language skills are not mandatory for admission. We recommend German level A2 for a good start in Germany.

note.fr: Il est fortement recommandé d'avoir au moins 18 ans au début des études.
note.en: Applicants are highly recommended to be at least 18 years old when starting their studies.

evidence.quote: We highly recommend that applicants are at least 18 years old when they start their studies.

note.fr: Les notes prédites ne sont pas acceptées. Les candidats de l'UE peuvent postuler avec le certificat du semestre d'hiver de la 12e classe.
note.en: Predicted grades are not accepted. EU applicants may apply with the certificate of the winter semester of the 12th class.

evidence.quote: We are unable to accept predicted grades. Applicants from an EU country may apply with the certificate of the winter semester of the 12th class.

note.fr: La candidature doit être complète pour être considérée.
note.en: The application must be complete to be considered.

evidence.quote: You cannot submit an application unless it is complete Please note that due to university admission regulations we cannot consider an application unless it is complete.

notes: Deux pages donnent des dates limites différentes pour les candidats non-UE : la page DAAD indique 15 mai (année non précisée) et la page apply.html indique 31 juillet comme date limite générale, avec une date recommandée du 15 mai pour les candidats internationaux ; ces dates sont des recommandations et non des échéances strictes.
